Despite strong trust in AI recommendations, data privacy concerns remain a barrier. The report also shows strong holiday spending intent, with 55% planning to spend more than last year, though consumers still favor familiar brands and major retailers like Amazon (81%), Walmart (71%), and Target (58%).

GS.title: Integrity Urgent Care Clinic Opens in Murphy, Texas
GS.summary: Integrity Urgent Care, a Texas-based urgent care provider, opened a new clinic in Murphy, Texas on August 3, 2026. The clinic offers walk-in urgent care, virtual primary care, on-site testing, and employer services across seven days a week. The company now operates 42 locations across Texas and is part of Integrity Care Group, backed by Goldman Sachs Sustainable Investment Fund.

WETH.title: WeTouch Secures Singapore Commercial Outdoor Project, Demonstrating Whole-Product Customization and Expanding Southeast Asia Footprint
WETH.summary: WeTouch Technology Inc. announced a significant milestone in its business model transition, successfully completing initial delivery of 1,000 customized 21.5-inch outdoor touch display units for a Singapore golf course application, with follow-on orders for 3,000 additional units expected to generate approximately $1.8 million in annual incremental revenue. The company plans to establish a Singapore Regional Operations Center to support expansion across Southeast Asia markets including Vietnam, Thailand, South Korea, and Japan.

FTLF.title: FitLife Brands Announces Second Quarter Earnings Call
FTLF.summary: FitLife Brands, Inc. (Nasdaq: FTLF), a nutritional supplements and wellness products provider, announced it will report its second quarter fiscal 2026 financial performance on August 13, 2026, followed by an investor conference call at 4:30 pm ET. The company markets over 500 products online and through retail locations from its Omaha, Nebraska headquarters.

CRARY.title: CREDIT AGRICOLE SA : DECLARATION DES DROITS DE VOTE JUILLET 2026
CRARY.summary: Crédit Agricole S.A. reports strong activity in Q2 2026 and announces acceleration of its AI transformation initiatives. The company maintains its capital structure with 3,025,902,350 total shares and 3,025,634,720 exercisable voting rights as of July 31, 2026.

SGPIY.title: Fortune Interview with Clifford Kang: How SERES Is Building Global Competitiveness Through ESG
SGPIY.summary: SERES Group, marking its 40th anniversary, discussed its ESG strategy and sustainability goals in an exclusive interview. The company achieved MSCI's highest AAA ESG rating as the only mainland-listed Chinese automaker to do so. SERES aims for carbon peak by 2030 and carbon neutrality by 2045, supported by its luxury AITO brand which surpassed one million cumulative deliveries. The company is implementing innovative supply chain practices including a 'factory-within-a-factory' model with 91 core suppliers to enhance sustainability and transparency.

SYK.title: Stryker declares an $0.88 per share quarterly dividend
SYK.summary: Stryker Corporation announced a quarterly dividend of $0.88 per share, representing a 4.8% increase year-over-year. The company reported second quarter 2026 net sales increased 9.4% to $6.6 billion, demonstrating solid financial performance across its medical technology divisions.

BABA.title: Nansha, Guangzhou, crea un nuevo ecosistema de comercio transfronterizo para conectar al mundo con nuevas oportunidades
BABA.summary: Nansha district in Guangzhou has developed an advanced automated port terminal and comprehensive cross-border trade ecosystem, handling over 22.6 million TEU in 2025 with 180+ international maritime routes. The district leverages digital innovation, institutional reforms, and strategic policies to facilitate international commerce across Asia-Pacific, with major e-commerce and logistics platforms operating in the region.

BABA.title: Connecting the World to New Opportunities - Guangzhou Nansha Builds a New Ecosystem for Cross-Border Trade
BABA.summary: Guangzhou Nansha District is emerging as a major international cross-border trade hub, leveraging advanced port automation, digital services, and institutional reforms. The Phase IV Automated Terminal at Guangzhou Port achieved 18% year-on-year container throughput growth in H1 2026, while cross-border e-commerce imports/exports reached RMB 74 billion in 2025, ranking first among China's comprehensive bonded zones for the sixth consecutive year.

XE.title: Stack Capital Group Inc. Reports Q2-2026 Financial Results
XE.summary: Stack Capital Group Inc. reported strong Q2 2026 results with Book Value per Share increasing 22% to $20.25 from $16.57 in Q1 2026, driven by significant gains across its portfolio including SpaceX's IPO at $1.77 trillion valuation, Project Prometheus investment at $41 billion valuation, and X-Energy's successful IPO. The company also invested $12 million in Fluidstack, which saw a 90% increase in carrying value following Anthropic's infrastructure partnership.

AIFF.title: Firefly Neuroscience (NASDAQ: AIFF) Reports 291% Increase in TMS Center Customer Brain Scan Volumes
AIFF.summary: Firefly Neuroscience announced a nearly four-fold increase in TMS center customer clinical assessments using its FDA-cleared Evoke AI-powered EEG/ERP platform. The platform combines quantitative EEG and event-related potentials to help clinicians assess brain activity and tailor treatments for psychiatric and behavioral health conditions. The company continues to expand adoption among TMS centers while building its proprietary database of over 200,000 EEG/ERP brain scans.

GNENY.title: Lithium Argentina Announces $220 Million of New Debt Facilities Closed at Cauchari-Olaroz
GNENY.summary: Lithium Argentina announced the closure of $220 million in new unsecured debt facilities for its Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation. The financing consists of a $50 million two-year facility and a $170 million three-year facility with an interest rate under 5%, supported by a guarantee from partner Ganfeng Lithium. The funds will strengthen the company's balance sheet and support Stage 2 expansion plans to increase production capacity by 45,000 tonnes per annum of lithium carbonate equivalent.

LAR.title: Lithium Argentina Announces $220 Million of New Debt Facilities Closed at Cauchari-Olaroz

KURA.title: Kura Oncology to Report Second Quarter Financial Results
KURA.summary: Kura Oncology announced it will report second quarter 2026 financial results on August 12, 2026, followed by a webcast. The company also reported durable clinical activity of its drug candidate darlifarnib plus cabozantinib in renal cell carcinoma patients, with response rates up to 50% and median PFS of 13 months observed in pre-treated, cabozantinib-naïve patients.

CRWS.title: Crown Crafts to Announce First Quarter 2027 Results on August 12, 2026
CRWS.summary: Crown Crafts, Inc. (NASDAQ-CM: CRWS), a producer and distributor of infant and juvenile consumer products, announced it will release first quarter fiscal 2027 results on August 12, 2026 after market close, followed by a teleconference with President and CEO Olivia W. Elliott and CFO Claire K. Spencer at 4:00 p.m. Central Time.

FLUT.title: Flutter Board announces CEO transition
FLUT.summary: Flutter Entertainment plc announced that Dan Taylor, currently CEO of Flutter's International division, will become Group Chief Executive Officer effective October 1, 2026, succeeding Peter Jackson. Taylor has led the International division to over $9 billion in annual revenue and $2.2 billion in Adjusted EBITDA in 2025, with a track record of strategic acquisitions, organic growth, and successful integration of major businesses across multiple regions.

FLUT.title: Flutter Announces Completion of Cancellation of Secondary Listing on London Stock Exchange; Primary Listing on NYSE Maintained
FLUT.summary: Flutter Entertainment plc has completed the cancellation of its secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange effective August 3, 2026. The company's shares are now exclusively listed on the New York Stock Exchange, consolidating its primary listing to a single exchange.

ETON.title: Eton Pharmaceuticals Expands Infantile Hemangioma Franchise with Acquisition of U.S. Rights to Late-Stage Product Candidate ASN-001
ETON.summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals has licensed U.S. rights to ASN-001 (timolol topical gel) from Auson Pharmaceuticals for treating moderate infantile hemangiomas. Phase II/III trial results showed 56% elimination rates at week 24 with twice-daily dosing versus 15% for placebo. The company plans to submit an NDA in H2 2027 with potential approval and launch in 2028, targeting an estimated 20,000-30,000 patients annually and positioning ASN-001 as a complementary product to its existing HEMANGEOL therapy.

ETON.title: Eton Pharmaceuticals to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, August 13, 2026
ETON.summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals announced it will report second quarter 2026 financial results on August 13, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. The company also announced a Prior Approval Supplement submission to expand KHINDIVI's indication for a larger pediatric patient population and expanded its rare disease portfolio through commercialization rights to IMPAVIDO®.

SYANY.title: Transactions with shares in AL Sydbank by managers and closely associated persons
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank A/S has disclosed transactions with shares conducted by managers and closely associated persons under Article 19 of the Market Abuse Regulation. The bank also reports on its ongoing share buyback programme activities for weeks 30 and 31 of 2026.

SYANY.title: Ledende medarbejdere og nærtståendes transaktioner med aktier i AL Sydbank
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank A/S publicly discloses transactions with bank shares executed by leading employees and their related parties in accordance with market abuse regulation article 19. The announcement includes detailed information on these transactions in attached schedules.

SYANY.title: AL Sydbank A/S share buyback programme: transactions in week 31
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank A/S completed its share buyback programme transactions for week 31 (27-31 July 2026), repurchasing 35,000 shares for DKK 21.5 million at an average weighted price ranging from DKK 607.60 to DKK 624.23. The bank has now accumulated 982,000 shares (1.12% of share capital) under its DKK 1.1 billion buyback programme, which runs through January 2027.

SYANY.title: Aktietilbagekøb i AL Sydbank A/S – transaktioner i uge 31
SYANY.summary: AL Sydbank A/S completed 35,000 share buybacks in week 31 (July 27-31, 2026) at an average price of 614.27 DKK per share, totaling 21.5 million DKK. The bank has now repurchased 982,000 shares (1.12% of share capital) under its 1.1 billion DKK buyback programme initiated in March 2026, which will conclude by January 31, 2027.

IVTJY.summary: Investec Bank plc, acting as Joint Broker to Gamma Communications Plc, disclosed public dealing in ordinary shares of Gamma Communications on August 4, 2026. The bank purchased and sold 82,076 ordinary shares at prices ranging from 960p to 961.67p per unit.

IVTJY.title: Form 8.5 (EPT/RI)-Advanced Medical Solutions Group Plc

SUHJY.title: Sun Hung Kai Properties Hong Kong Cyclothon Returns on 11 October
SUHJY.summary: The Hong Kong Cyclothon, organized by the Hong Kong Tourism Board, will return on October 11, 2026, featuring two scenic cycling routes (56km and 32km) through Hong Kong's iconic landmarks and cityscapes. Registration opens on August 20, with over 6,000 cyclists expected to participate in this non-competitive event starting from West Kowloon Cultural District. The event will include a carnival with sports, entertainment, and family-friendly activities.

SUHJY.title: 「新鴻基地產香港單車節」10月11日載譽歸來
SUHJY.summary: The Hong Kong Tourism Board is hosting the 2026 Hong Kong Cyclothon on October 11, featuring 56km and 32km non-competitive cycling routes. Registration opens August 20. YMAX.title: YieldMax® ETFs Announces Weekly Distributions for Group 1 ETFs

RYTM.title: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals Announces Preliminary Data from Phase 2 Trial that Showed RM-718 Demonstrated Positive Efficacy Signal in Acquired Hypothalamic Obesity
RYTM.summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals announced preliminary Phase 2 trial results for RM-718, an investigational MC4R agonist, showing an 11.6% mean BMI reduction in acquired hypothalamic obesity patients at 16 weeks. The efficacy is comparable to existing treatments setmelanotide and bivamelagon, with notably reduced hyperpigmentation side effects (only 2 mild injection site cases). The company will discuss Q2 2026 financial results in a conference call.

SMG.title: ScottsMiracle-Gro Announces Financial Targets and Capital Allocation Strategy During Investor Day 2026 at NYSE

SOLZ.summary: Pepeto's presale has raised over $10.398 million with accelerating demand and record holder growth. Solana has rebounded above $80 with analyst predictions averaging $500 for 2026. The article suggests that large capital inflows from money market funds ($8 trillion) could drive crypto recovery, with early investors in emerging projects like Pepeto potentially positioned for significant gains.

BC.title: Brunswick Corporation Releases Investor Day Materials Highlighting Long-Term Growth Strategy
BC.summary: Brunswick Corporation made its 2026 Investor Day materials available, including a recorded strategy presentation and slides detailing the company's strategic priorities, growth opportunities, and financial outlook. CCB.summary: Coastal Financial Corporation (CCB) is under investigation for possible federal securities law violations following the announcement of a $42.1 million net loss in Q2 2026, primarily due to a $68.8 million credit expense related to a single partner relationship. The stock fell 42.88% on the news, prompting a class action investigation for affected shareholders.

GRAL.title: PICS FINAL DEADLINE ALERT: PicS N.V. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Class Action Lawsuit Before August 4, 2026 Deadline – Hagens Berman
GRAL.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against PicS N.V. (NASDAQ: PICS) alleging the company made materially false and misleading statements in its January 2026 IPO by failing to disclose internal findings of deficient credit evaluation policies discovered in December 2025. The lawsuit claims these omissions masked severe portfolio deterioration, heightened default risks, and increased non-performing loans. Post-IPO disclosures revealed R$590 million in loan reclassifications and a doubled default formation rate, causing the stock to plummet over 50% from its $19.00 IPO price to under $9.00. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

GRAL.title: GRAL FINAL DEADLINE ALERT: GRAIL, Inc. (NASDAQ: GRAL) Investors Urged to Contact Hagens Berman; Securities Fraud Class Action Filed, August 4, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline
GRAL.summary: Hagens Berman has filed a securities fraud class action lawsuit against GRAIL, Inc. (NASDAQ: GRAL) alleging the company misled investors about its NHS-Galleri cancer screening trial's design and efficacy. GRAIL failed to meet the trial's primary endpoint on February 19, 2026, causing the stock to plummet 50.55% and erasing $2.2 billion in market capitalization. The lead plaintiff deadline is August 4, 2026.

CWT.title: California Water Service and County of Tulare Complete Project to Bring Safe, Reliable Water to Harrison Road Water Users
CWT.summary: California Water Service, in partnership with Tulare County, the State of California's Department of Water Resources, and Self-Help Enterprises, completed a water infrastructure project connecting 27 customers along Harrison Road whose wells had gone dry. The project, funded by over $1.3 million through ARPA and drought relief programs, installed approximately 2,600 feet of water pipes and five fire hydrants to extend safe drinking water access to an underserved community.

DNTH.title: Dianthus Therapeutics Announces Inducement Grants Under NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(C)(4)
DNTH.summary: Dianthus Therapeutics granted equity awards to six newly-hired non-executive employees on August 3, 2026, consisting of non-qualified stock options to purchase 87,000 shares at an exercise price of $106.02 per share with a 10-year term. NUTR.title: NusaTrip Incorporated Notified of Anticipated Delisting from The Nasdaq Stock Market
NUTR.summary: Nasdaq announced on August 3, 2026, that NusaTrip Incorporated (NUTR) will be delisted from the Nasdaq Stock Market on August 12, 2026, unless the company appeals. MAGH.title: Magnitude International Ltd. Notified of Anticipated Delisting from The Nasdaq Stock Market
MAGH.summary: Nasdaq announced on August 3, 2026, that it will delist Magnitude International Ltd. (MAGH) from the Nasdaq Stock Market on August 12, 2026, unless the company appeals. SAFRY.title: El R88 de Robinson hace su debut en Sudamérica en LABACE 2026; el robusto helicóptero multimisión está listo para revolucionar el mercado latinoamericano
SAFRY.summary: Robinson Helicopter Company is debuting its R88 helicopter in Brazil at LABACE 2026 (August 4-6). The 10-seat, multi-mission aircraft features a Safran Arriel 2W engine, 3,000+ lbs payload capacity, and over 3.5 hours of flight range. The company positions the R88 as a cost-effective solution between light single-engine and expensive twin-engine helicopters for executive transport, agriculture, and utility operations in Latin America.

CVGI.summary: CVG reported Q2 2026 revenues of $195.2 million, up 13.5% year-over-year, with gross margin expansion of 140 basis points. APMD.title: Apnimed Announces Closing of Upsized Initial Public Offering, Including Full Exercise of Underwriters’ Option to Purchase Additional Shares
APMD.summary: Apnimed, Inc. (Nasdaq: APMD) closed its upsized IPO on August 3, 2026, raising $220.8 million gross proceeds by selling 13.8 million shares at $16.00 per share, including full exercise of underwriters' overallotment option. TIGR.title: UP Fintech Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in UP Fintech Holding Limited (NASDAQ: TIGR), You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights

ADYEY.title: MannyPay Global Launches Global Payment Facilitator Platform with iMerchant, Powered by Adyen

NATR.summary: Nature's Sunshine Products, Inc. (NASDAQ: NATR) announced the appointment of Janine Weber as Executive Vice President and President, North America, effective August 10, 2026. This sale is part of Worldline's broader portfolio optimization, with combined proceeds from all announced divestitures expected between €590-640 million in 2026.
